name: Alex Hormozi Grand Slam Offer Framework
description: Complete offer creation system based on Alex Hormozi's $100M Offers methodology for creating irresistible offers

dream_outcome.definition: What the customer ultimately desires to achieve
maximization_strategies: Identify the ultimate transformation the customer wants
Paint the picture of their ideal future state
Quantify the outcome with specific metrics
Connect to emotional desires and deeper motivations
templates: Transform from [current frustrating state] to [desired state]

perceived_likelihood.definition: Customer's belief that they can achieve the desired result
maximization_strategies: Provide social proof and success stories
Demonstrate your track record and expertise
proof_elements: Case studies with specific results and timelines

time_delay.definition: Time it takes for customer to achieve the result
minimization_strategies: Emphasize quick wins and early results
Break down timeline into achievable milestones
Show accelerated path compared to alternatives

effort_sacrifice.definition: Effort or inconvenience customer must endure
minimization_strategies: Simplify the process and remove complexity

massive_pain.description: Prospects must have desperate need, not want
validation_questions: Do they have an urgent, pressing problem?
Is this a must-have vs nice-to-have?
Are there painful consequences for inaction?

purchasing_power.description: Prospects must afford or access money needed

easy_to_target.description: Audience should be in easy-to-target markets

growing_market.description: Market should be growing to accelerate success

core_offer.description: The main product or service being offered

bonuses_stack.description: Additional value elements that increase perceived value

scarcity_urgency.description: Elements that create urgency and scarcity

guarantee_risk_reversal.description: Risk reversal mechanisms that remove purchase barriers

naming_strategies.pattern: How to [Achieve Outcome] Even If [Limiting Belief]
naming_strategies.example: How to Build a Business Even If You Have No Experience

hormozi_7_step_process.description: What narrow, specific issue will you solve
hormozi_7_step_process.implementation: Identify single biggest pain point in customer journey
Provide immediate value and quick win

hormozi_7_step_process.description: PDF, free trial, video, checklist, etc.
hormozi_7_step_process.implementation: Choose format that best delivers the solution
Use naming frameworks for compelling titles
Remove friction and complexity from access/consumption
Exceed expectations to build trust and reciprocity

hormozi_7_step_process.description: Tell them what to do next
hormozi_7_step_process.implementation: Clear next step toward main offer or engagement

testing_methodology.sequential_testing: Test one element at a time for clear attribution
testing_methodology.statistical_significance: Ensure adequate sample size for valid results
testing_methodology.performance_metrics: Track conversion, revenue, and customer lifetime value

market_validation: Validate massive pain exists in market
Confirm purchasing power of target audience
Ensure market is easy to target with advertising
Verify market growth trends and opportunities
value_equation_optimization: Define clear dream outcome for customers
Maximize perceived likelihood with proof elements
Minimize time delay with speed amplifiers
offer_construction: Develop core offer with clear value
lead_magnet_creation: Align lead magnet with core offer
Create clear path to main offer

conversion_targets.offer_conversion: 2-15% depending on price point and market
